project.name: pebble-compiler
project.summary: A curated parser/compiler miniature with explicit transformation stages.
project.thesis: Source input passes explicit transformation stages before a checked output is emitted.

planes.label: Transform
planes.purpose: Lower syntax to an intermediate form.

nodes.label: Source Input
nodes.description: Begins compilation at the public compile_source function accepting source text.
nodes.why_it_matters: It defines the public input boundary of the pipeline.
nodes.inspector_summary: compile_source supplies source text to the ordered transformation.

nodes.label: Parser
nodes.description: Converts source text into the explicit SyntaxTree representation.
nodes.why_it_matters: It is the first transformation stage evidenced in source.
nodes.inspector_summary: parse creates SyntaxTree before lowering begins.

nodes.label: Intermediate Form
nodes.description: Captures the lowered instruction representation consumed by the emitter.
nodes.inspector_summary: IntermediateForm records the result of lower.

nodes.label: Emitter
nodes.description: Formats lowered instructions into the final emitted text output.

workflows.label: Compile Source
workflows.description: Transform text through parsing, lowering, and emission.

decision_record.repository_thesis_summary: Source input passes explicit transformation stages before a checked output is emitted.

projection_candidates.label: Transformation Stages
projection_candidates.question_answered: How is source transformed into emitted output?
distortion_risks: The miniature does not model error recovery.
projection_candidates.selection_reason: The implementation explicitly composes the ordered stages.

projection_candidates.label: Symbol Inventory
projection_candidates.selection_reason: The pipeline is the stronger architectural explanation.

scenario_candidates.label: Compile Source
scenario_candidates.reason: The public function records the ordered transformation.

over_centralization_risks.risk: The intermediate representation could hide the input/output contract.
over_centralization_risks.mitigation: Retain source and emitter as visible landmarks.

projections.label: Transformation Stages
projections.question_answered: How is source transformed into emitted output?

steps.title: Accept Source
steps.narration: The public compile function accepts the source text input.

steps.title: Parse Syntax
steps.narration: The parser converts that input into a SyntaxTree representation.

steps.title: Lower Form
steps.narration: Lowering produces the intermediate instruction form for output.

steps.title: Emit Output
steps.narration: The emitter produces the final textual output of compilation.
